description: Mailbox conformance vectors (06-implementatieplan-v1.md par. 3.17). Run by examples/mailbox_server/meshcore-mailboxd/tests/conformance.rs and test/test_rdm_mailbox_conformance. Rules: examples/mailbox_server/meshcore-mailboxd/README.md.

format.t: mailbox clock in seconds (unix time); steps are ordered, housekeeping runs at t before each op
format.id: request id is the step index within the case
format.owner_add: args pub(32 hex), k_owner(16 hex), ttl_days, sync_days, quota; owner prefix = pub[0:4]
format.reg: args sender, owner, token; expect code, ttl_days, quota
format.store: args owner, sender, hash, payload (hex); expect code, expires
format.fetch: args client, flags, store_id (4 hex), reports[{hash, result, ack}]; expect code, remaining, reports_ok, payload (hex or null)
format.stat: args sender, hashes; expect code, items[{state, ack}]
format.advance: only moves the clock to t and runs housekeeping

cases.name: reg_valid_token
cases.doc: Valid token_B = HMAC(K_owner, sender)[0:8] gives OK with the owner's ttl and quota.

cases.name: reg_custom_owner_limits
cases.doc: ttl_days and quota come from the owner row.

cases.name: reg_unknown_owner
cases.doc: No owner with that 4-byte prefix.

cases.name: reg_wrong_token
cases.doc: A token for another sender or from another owner key is rejected.

cases.name: reg_denied
cases.doc: A denylisted sender gets NOT_AUTH even with a valid token; other senders and owners are unaffected.

cases.name: store_requires_registration
cases.doc: DEPOSIT from a sender that never registered with this owner is NOT_AUTH.

cases.name: store_unknown_owner
cases.doc: DEPOSIT for an owner prefix the Pi does not know.

cases.name: store_expires_from_owner_ttl
cases.doc: expires = deposit time + ttl_days of the owner.

cases.name: store_already_stored
cases.doc: Same pkt_hash again (lost DEPOSIT reply) gives ALREADY_STORED with the original expires.

cases.name: store_same_hash_other_sender
cases.doc: A pkt_hash that belongs to another sender is not acknowledged.

cases.name: store_too_big
cases.doc: Inner payload above 164 bytes is TOO_BIG; exactly 164 fits.

cases.name: store_quota
cases.doc: Quota counts live messages (STORED, SENT, ON_RADIO) per sender and owner; a final state frees it.

cases.name: store_after_deny
cases.doc: After deny the sender cannot deposit; messages already stored stay deliverable.

cases.name: fetch_only_owner
cases.doc: FETCH is only answered for an owner pubkey; depositors and strangers get NOT_AUTH.

cases.name: fetch_flow_on_radio_synced
cases.doc: One copy per reply; reports move SENT to ON_RADIO and ON_RADIO to DELIVERED.

cases.name: fetch_sent_without_report_back_to_stored
cases.doc: A copy that the next FETCH does not report is offered again.

cases.name: fetch_oldest_first_remaining
cases.doc: Copies go out oldest first; remaining counts STORED after this reply.

cases.name: fetch_rotates_senders
cases.doc: Oldest copy per sender, senders in pubkey order after the sender of the previous copy, wrapping around, so one sender above quota does not hold up the others.

cases.name: fetch_lost_copy_waits_its_turn
cases.doc: A copy without report goes back to STORED and comes again when its sender is next.

cases.name: fetch_no_payload_keeps_rotation
cases.doc: A FETCH without a copy does not move the rotation.

cases.name: fetch_inbox_full
cases.doc: INBOX_FULL puts the copy back to STORED; NO_PAYLOAD returns only the count.

cases.name: fetch_undecryptable_rejected
cases.doc: UNDECRYPTABLE (Alice does not know Bob) is final: REJECTED, never offered again.

cases.name: fetch_duplicate_is_on_radio
cases.doc: DUPLICATE (Alice already had it directly) counts as ON_RADIO with ACK_R.

cases.name: fetch_synced_from_sent
cases.doc: SYNCED may arrive before any ON_RADIO report.

cases.name: fetch_report_for_stored
cases.doc: An ON_RADIO report for a copy that was put back to STORED still counts: Alice has it.

cases.name: fetch_invalid_transitions_ignored
cases.doc: Reports that do not fit the state change nothing but are confirmed.

cases.name: fetch_reports_unknown_or_foreign_confirmed
cases.doc: Reports for unknown hashes or for another owner's messages are confirmed and change nothing.

cases.name: fetch_owners_isolated
cases.doc: An owner only receives copies deposited for that owner.

cases.name: resync_redelivers_on_radio
cases.doc: A FETCH with another store_id than the previous one puts ON_RADIO and SENT back to STORED (G12).

cases.name: resync_restarts_t_radio
cases.doc: A message put back to STORED by a resync gets a new T_radio from that moment (G12).

cases.name: resync_keeps_final
cases.doc: DELIVERED has no ciphertext left and stays DELIVERED after a resync.

cases.name: resync_per_owner
cases.doc: store_id is tracked per owner.

cases.name: t_radio_expiry
cases.doc: STORED and SENT expire at expires (T_radio); the copy is no longer offered.

cases.name: t_sync_expiry
cases.doc: ON_RADIO without SYNCED report becomes SYNC_EXPIRED after sync_days; ACK_R stays available.

cases.name: t_sync_owner_days
cases.doc: sync_days comes from the owner row.

cases.name: final_states_removed_after_30_days
cases.doc: DELIVERED, REJECTED and EXPIRED rows are removed 30 days after the final state.

cases.name: expired_removed_after_30_days
cases.doc: EXPIRED counts from the moment it expired.

cases.name: stat_only_own_messages
cases.doc: STATUS reveals only the asking sender's own messages; anything else is UNKNOWN.

cases.name: stat_batch_of_eight
cases.doc: Up to eight hashes per STATUS, answered in order.
